note: Assistant safety rules, reviewed by the medical team like the protocols. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regular expressions matched on text with accents removed. Each rule id shows in the guard report and in assistant_log. Illustrative: NOT clinically reviewed.

precheck.description: Acute emergencies go to Guided Response, never to a chat answer.
patterns: \b(seizure|convuls\w*|not breathing|unconscious|passed out|choking|can'?t breathe|heavy bleeding|bleeding (heavily|a lot)|chest pain (now|right now)|having a heart attack|anaphyla\w*)\b

precheck.description: Someone who cannot be woken, is unresponsive, has blue lips, fainted, collapsed, has a severe allergic reaction or an overdose.
Self-harm or suicide phrasing goes to the crisis protocol.
Attempts to make the assistant ignore its rules, play a doctor or skip a protocol are refused and logged.
No medication or doses: the crew medical officer decides that.
More dosing phrasings: how much can I take, increasing or stopping a medication, painkillers, sleeping pills, named drugs.
No diagnosis: Canary shows numbers against the person's normal, the medical officer interprets them.
patterns: \b(do i have|have i got|is (it|this) (cancer|a tumou?r|a stroke|serious)|diagnos\w*|what disease|what illness)\b

precheck.description: More diagnosis phrasings: is it a (condition), could this be (a condition), am I sick with, what's wrong with me.

answers.emergency: This sounds like an emergency. Hold the EMERGENCY button now: Guided Response will take you through it step by step and alert the crew and Earth.
answers.crisis: Thank you for saying it. You are not alone with this. Hold the EMERGENCY button now and choose the crisis protocol: it alerts the medical officer, who will talk with you right away.
answers.dosing: I can't advise on medication or doses. The crew medical officer decides that, with the flight surgeon. I can send them a message with your recent data.
answers.diagnosis: I can't diagnose. I can show what your numbers did against your own normal, and the medical officer can take it from there.
answers.inject: I can't change how I work. I stay within Canary's safety rules and the approved protocols. Ask me about your own data, or talk to the crew medical officer.

postcheck.description: The final answer is valid JSON in the AssistantResponse shape.
Every source id of a claim was returned by a tool in this turn.
Observations cite data ids; explanations cite kb: (or legacy card: / protocol:) ids.
Every number in the answer and observations appears in this turn's tool data (unit-aware: 6.1 h, 104 bpm).
No dose or medication instruction in the output.
patterns: \b(you should|you can|you could|it is ok to|it's ok to) take (some |more )?(ibuprofen|paracetamol|acetaminophen|aspirin|melatonin|modafinil|zolpidem|an? antihistamine|promethazine|scopolamine|codeine|morphine|antibiotics?|a painkiller|a sleeping pill)\b

postcheck.description: No diagnosis wording in the output.
patterns: \byou (have|'ve got|have got|are suffering from|suffer from|are showing signs of) (an? )?([\w-]+ ){0,2}(disease|disorder|infection|syndrome|cancer|tumou?r|stroke|condition|illness|concussion|diabetes|hypertension|arrhythmia|anemia|anaemia|pneumonia|fracture)\b

\b(this|it|that) (is|looks like|sounds like|could be|might be|is probably|is likely) (an? )?(sign of (an? )?)?([\w-]+ ){0,2}(stroke|heart attack|tumou?r|cancer|infection|disease|disorder|syndrome|concussion|fracture|arrhythmia)\b

postcheck.description: No reassurance that something is safe or harmless: a value without context is never called safe.
recommended_action_id is goal: from today's list, protocol: from the bank, contact_cmo, send_briefing or null.
supported with no surviving observation becomes insufficient_evidence.
Nothing about another crew member's health, status or data. Names come from catalog.CREW; the bound person is exempt. Also drops claims citing another person's data ids.
No crew averages or comparisons with the others: with four people an average reveals individuals.
patterns: \b(compared|relative) (to|with) (the )?(crew|team|others|everyone else|the rest of the crew|your crewmates)\b
\b(than|as) (the )?(rest of the crew|other crew members|your crewmates|everyone else|the others)\b

postcheck.description: Wellbeing check-ins (PHQ-2 / GAD-2) are screening, never a diagnosis.
patterns: \byou (are|'re|seem|sound|might be|may be|could be|are probably|are likely) (clinically )?(depressed|mentally ill)\b
\byou (have|'ve got|have got|suffer from|are suffering from|are showing signs of|show signs of) (depression|anxiety|an? (mental|mood|anxiety) (illness|disorder))\b
